description:
One Shot Hotels Assistant helps guests explore the chain, find hotel information, check room availability and prices, and review room types and optional extras.
Guests can ask about hotel amenities, services, policies, and check-in and check-out times. The assistant can also help create a booking after explicit confirmation and retrieve, modify, or cancel an existing booking when the required booking details are provided.
Example questions:
“Which One Shot Hotels can I choose from?”
“What are the check-in and check-out times at One Shot Prado?”
“What room types are available?”
“Do you have rooms for two adults next weekend?”
“Help me change my booking dates.”

Reservation actions may require booking details and guest information. Availability and conditions are provided by the hotel booking system.

name: one-shot-hotels

positive.description: List One Shot Hotels properties in the chain.
positive.prompt: Which One Shot Hotels can I choose from?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the official list of One Shot Hotels properties with guest-facing names and locations, without exposing internal hotel or chain identifiers.

positive.prompt: What benefits does One Shot Friends offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains One Shot Friends benefits from official chain information, including the additional website discount, private sales, early check-in and late check-out and other member perks, without asking for personal data.

positive.description: Answer hotel-specific amenity and policy questions.
positive.prompt: At One Shot Buenavista in Ibiza, what are the check-in and check-out times, and does it have a pool?
positive.expected_behavior: Matches One Shot Buenavista to the correct hotel, retrieves the hotel profile, and answers with official check-in, check-out, and pool information only.

positive.description: List room details for a specific hotel.
positive.prompt: What room types does One Shot Prado offer, including capacities and bed configurations?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns room names, capacities, sizes, bed configurations, and relevant amenities for One Shot Prado from the room profiles.

positive.description: Check availability without creating a booking.
positive.prompt: Do you have rooms at One Shot Aragó for 2 adults from February 12, 2027 to February 14, 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available rooms, board options, prices, tax status, and cancellation summaries if available; otherwise clearly says no availability was found.

negative.description: An unrelated cooking request must not trigger the hotel tools.
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for a good chocolate cake.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any One Shot Hotels tool. The request is unrelated to the hotels, so it is handled without the plugin.

negative.description: A general knowledge question must not trigger the hotel tools.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any One Shot Hotels tool or mention One Shot Hotels. The question is answered without using the plugin.

negative.description: An unrelated coding request must not trigger the hotel tools.
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that checks whether a number is prime.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any One Shot Hotels tool. The request is unrelated to hotel information or reservations, so it is handled without the plugin.

review.commerce_description: The plugin supports One Shot Hotels accommodation reservations and optional stay-related extras across the chain's properties. Booking creation, date-change acceptance and full cancellation require explicit guest confirmation. Payment or finalization, when required, is completed through the hotel booking system link outside chat; card details are not collected in chat.

publication.release_notes: Initial release of One Shot Hotels with chain hotel directory, hotel information, availability, reservations and conversation ratings.
